status: PROPOSED - authored by the remediation pass, not approved by an accountable owner

requirements.text: Each session SHALL run in its own isolation boundary with no shared writable filesystem, process, network namespace, memory or device state.
requirements.acceptance: Two sessions' owned host resource sets are disjoint; reference guest state of one session is never visible to another.

requirements.text: Every session SHALL start from the approved clean base snapshot and nothing else.
requirements.acceptance: READY is refused unless the guest digest equals the base digest.

requirements.text: Egress SHALL NOT reach any destination not bound by a capability issued from the current allowlist, including via CNAME, rebinding, literal-IP, private, link-local, metadata or zone-ID forms.
requirements.post: decision logged with resolved and selected address
requirements.acceptance: All egress binding tests deny; enforcement rejects any tuple other than the bound one.

requirements.text: Session resource limits SHALL be enforced outside the guest (cgroup v2 + Firecracker limits) and admission SHALL reject work that would exceed tenant or node ceilings.
requirements.acceptance: Rendered plan carries cpu.max, memory.max, memory.swap.max=0, pids.max, fd/fsize rlimits, IO and network rate limiters; admission rejects over-quota/over-capacity.

requirements.text: A session SHALL be reported CLOSED only after teardown is verified: guest state cleared and no owned host resource observed.
requirements.acceptance: Any leaked owned resource moves the session to QUARANTINED and emits a teardown-failure metric.

requirements.text: Every control-plane request SHALL be authenticated (audience, expiry with bounded skew, single-use nonce, revocation) and authorized default-deny with tenant and site binding.
requirements.acceptance: Anonymous, expired, wrong-audience, forged, replayed, revoked, cross-tenant and cross-site requests are rejected with stable codes.

requirements.text: Security-sensitive changes (artifact promotion, rollback, egress policy, config activation, emergency re-enable) SHALL require two distinct principals.
requirements.acceptance: Self-approval and single-principal requests are denied.

requirements.text: Executable and policy artifacts SHALL be loaded only when their digest and version match a signed, non-stale, non-revoked approved manifest with no floating tags.
requirements.acceptance: Tampered, wrong-signer, replayed, floating, revoked and unpinned manifests are refused.

requirements.text: Security audit events SHALL be durably written, hash-chained, MAC'd and checkpoint-anchored off-node before the guarded action is acknowledged; the stream SHALL refuse rather than drop events.
requirements.acceptance: Mutation, deletion, reorder, duplication and tail truncation are detected; a full spool fails the guarded action and commits nothing.

requirements.text: Loss of a security-critical dependency (identity, attestation, policy, keys, trusted time, artifact verification, audit sink, DNS) SHALL fail new trust decisions closed after its bounded grace.
requirements.acceptance: New creates are refused with DEPENDENCY.TRUST_UNAVAILABLE; noncritical loss yields DEGRADED only.

requirements.text: Only legal lifecycle transitions SHALL be accepted, each from its declared initiator.
requirements.acceptance: Random walks over all (state, target, initiator) triples accept only tabled edges.

requirements.text: Commands from a controller that does not hold the current fencing epoch SHALL be rejected; epochs SHALL never be reissued.
requirements.acceptance: Stale-epoch teardown fails; sid reuse gets a new, never-seen epoch.

requirements.text: Mutating calls SHALL be idempotent per key within a window; reuse of a key with a different request SHALL be rejected.
requirements.acceptance: Replay returns the identical response and no second reservation; changed body is refused.

requirements.text: Denials and integrity failures SHALL NOT be retried; retryable failures SHALL use bounded full-jitter backoff under the caller deadline.
requirements.acceptance: Retry library performs exactly one attempt for never-class codes; attempts and elapsed time are capped.

requirements.text: Configuration SHALL be validated, signed and activated as a whole generation after all participants prepare; no layer SHALL override a locked security invariant; stale writers SHALL be rejected.
requirements.acceptance: Forbidden overrides, unsigned configs, participant rejection and stale generations leave the previous generation active.

requirements.text: Emergency controls (global/tenant/node disable, freeze, quarantine) SHALL take effect immediately, require a reason and incident id, and remain usable under overload via reserved capacity.
requirements.acceptance: Disable blocks creates; re-enable requires a second principal; management priority admits into the reserve.

requirements.text: Every automated allow/deny decision SHALL carry a registry reason code and digest-referenced inputs; explain views SHALL be tenant-scoped.
requirements.acceptance: Explain records exist for denials; free-text reasons are refused; other-tenant callers see nothing.

requirements.text: Metrics SHALL NOT carry unbounded or tenant-identifying label values.
requirements.acceptance: Label values outside declared vocabularies raise CardinalityError.

requirements.text: Control-plane state SHALL remain bounded under churn.
requirements.acceptance: After compaction, sessions and leases return to zero; bounded logs respect limits.

requirements.text: Peers outside the supported version window, or requiring an unsupported feature, SHALL be refused; unlisted runtime combinations SHALL NOT be deployable.
requirements.acceptance: Negotiation raises COMPAT.UNSUPPORTED_VERSION; deployable() is false for untested rows.

requirements.text: A node SHALL be admitted only after a qualification report shows KVM, cgroup v2, kernel, memory, CPU virtualization flags, no nested virtualization and time sync for its profile.
requirements.acceptance: Qualification of any missing prerequisite returns REJECT.

requirements.text: Untrusted-input parsers SHALL either return a canonical value or raise their declared rejection for any input.
requirements.acceptance: Fuzz harness reports zero findings for the release seed set.

requirements.text: External conformance through pk_core SHALL count only when pk_core is pinned by digest and verified; absence SHALL report NOT_RUN.
requirements.acceptance: Probe returns NOT_RUN/FAILED/VERIFIED correctly.
